description:
Shaun Golden
MONMOUNTY COUNTY SHERIFF
NOTICE OF FORECLOSURE SALE
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
MONMOUTH COUNTY
CHANCERY DIVISION
Docket No. F00358724
Sheriff’s File # 26002251
PLAINTIFF – Fifth Third Bank, National Association vs:
DEFENDANTS- Gerard Matthew Stahl, et al
By virtue of a writ of execution in the above stated action to me directed, I shall expose for sale at public vendue, at Monmouth County Sheriff’s Office Public Safety Center, 2500 Kozloski Road, in the township of Freehold, county of Monmouth, New Jersey, on
Monday, the 11th day of January 2027
at 1 o’clock, P.M. prevailing time. The property to be sold is located in Ocean Grove, in the County of Monmouth, State of New Jersey.
Lot Block Number if available: Tax Lot 8 Qualifier C213 Block 220 Tax Map of the Township of Neptune
COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
66 Whitefield Avenue, Unit 113 Ocean Grove, NJ 07756
Dimensions of Lot:
Together with an undivided 0.7396% interest in and to the common elements of Hardy Building of the Embury Arms a Condominium
Nearest Cross Street: Heck Ave
Estimated upset bid amount: $415,000.00 plus any additional sums as ordered by the court.
Occupancy Status: Owner Occupied
2026 Qtr. 4 Due: 11/01/2026 $1,965.72 OPEN
2027 Qtr. 1 Due: 02/01/2027 $1,920.77 OPEN
2027 Qtr. 2 Due: 05/01/2027 $1,920.77 OPEN
Sewer: Ocean Grove Sewer Authority, 1900 State Route 33 Neptune NJ 07753, 732-775-8705, ACCT# 2072.00-2026 SEWER SERVICE FEE; $2.25 OPEN + PENALTY
**PROSPECTIVE PURCHASERS ARE TAKING THE PROPERTY SUBJECT TO THE RIGHTS AND INTERESTS OF OCEAN GROVE CAMPGROUND ASSOCIATION AND ALSO TO THE CONDOMINIUM RULES, REGULATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS OF EMBURY ARMS CONDOMINIUM ASSOCIATION, INC.**
Notice Through Publication.
*Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation.
To ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so, the current amount due thereon.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
A full legal description of the premises can be found in the Office of The Sheriff of Monmouth County.
TERMS OF SALE: DEPOSIT: 20% of the bid amount at the time of sale. Balance due in 30 days. Cash (with a limit of $1,000.00) or cashier’s check only.
The approximate judgment amount is the sum of $413,921.11.
The judgment amount may be subject to further Orders of additional sums. The successful bidder will be responsible for all fees, commissions and costs of sale.
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn this sale without further notice by publication.
Shaun Golden, Sheriff
DATED: October 29, 2026
Robertson, Anschutz, Schneid, Crane & Partners, PLLC
130 Clinton Road, Suite 202
Fairfield, NJ 07004
